title: Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G - 8GB RAM, 256GB Storage
description: Redmi Note 13 Pro 5G features a 120 Hz AMOLED display, 200 MP OIS main camera, Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 processor and 67 W turbo charging. Sleek design with Corning Gorilla Glass protection.

reviews.author: Sneha M.
reviews.title: Excellent display
reviews.body: AMOLED screen is vibrant and the camera clicks sharp photos in daylight.

reviews.author: Vikram J.
reviews.title: Smooth performance
reviews.body: Gaming and multitasking are lag-free. Battery lasts a full day.

reviews.author: Kavita L.
reviews.title: Heats up slightly
reviews.body: Phone gets warm during extended camera use.
